_instructions: CRITICAL: keep this package app-partner bounded. External surfaces are included only as proven mandatory Partner counterparts; no other application becomes independent scope. Current baseline is BB@f48d27e09e17dffaa471f394a46cd2878d3c1d86.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines authority, exact-candidate discipline, CODE_BASED_LEAN and truth-owner boundaries.
evidenceIndex.result: Partner implementation must correct authoritative owners, migrate only affected consumers, remove obsolete parallel truth and remain exact-SHA evidence bound.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Normative authority is not runtime proof.

evidenceIndex.claim: Requires existing-package RESUME_AND_RECONCILE, root-cause planning, stale rebaseline and no unrelated expansion.
evidenceIndex.result: The existing Partner package is rebaselined in place; no duplicate package or unit family is created.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Prompting guidance does not prove product behavior.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows 314 commits of drift after the package's prior observed head.
evidenceIndex.result: Drift includes app-partner runtime wrappers, Identity session/refresh, WLT Product Truth, migration/runtime/CI changes; old exact-SHA evidence is stale.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Diff inventory does not prove correctness of changed code.

evidenceIndex.result: SecureStore session, stable device fingerprint, Partner push, exact partner/app-partner IdentitySessionGate, PartnerFieldRatingGate and DshPartnerSurface are current runtime paths.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static composition does not prove live session/device behavior.

evidenceIndex.result: Partner flows compose shared canonical models and Store context is server-read/re-authorized; selected Store remains intent rather than authorization.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Frontend composition does not prove database/server invariants.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines current Partner onboarding/publication lifecycle and counterpart surfaces.
evidenceIndex.result: State remains READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION; app-field/control-panel/app-client are required only for the same onboarding/publication journey; DSH owns Partner/Store truth and WLT owns payout destination truth.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines Partner support/rescue ownership and counterpart rules.
evidenceIndex.result: State remains DISCOVERY; Partner support is order/Store scoped, operator owns rescue transitions, and DSH rescue cannot become WLT financial truth.

evidenceIndex.claim: Reproduces the selected-Store analytics semantic mismatch on current BB.
evidenceIndex.result: UI depends on/displays canonicalStoreId, request sends period only, backend resolves Store through partnerStore.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Evidence proves mismatch, not which product semantic should win.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines current Partner WLT payout/destination/financial truth requirements.
evidenceIndex.result: Partner destination is read-only; payout intent is FULL_AVAILABLE/SPECIFIED; WLT resolves eligibility/current verified destination and owns unknown-result reconciliation and all authoritative financial values.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Capability remains DISCOVERY and requires exact-candidate finance evidence.

evidenceIndex.result: Current UI is substantially aligned with read-only masked destination, FULL_AVAILABLE/SPECIFIED intent, idempotency key persistence and provider_result_unknown reconciliation presentation.
evidenceIndex.limitations: UI presence does not prove WLT authorization, ledger or provider reconciliation.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows current Identity session/refresh blast radius added after prior Partner baseline.
evidenceIndex.result: U001 must verify concurrent refresh single-winner/replay/conflict plus mobile outage/session-surface behavior on the Partner candidate.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows current Partner post-onboarding field-rating slice.
evidenceIndex.result: Partner runtime exposes dismissible post-onboarding field feedback backed by DSH APIs/persistence; it is not an access gate and was absent from the old package.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Current Product/PRD semantics and duplicate/isolation behavior still require verification.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows stale Partner Fleet migration evidence metadata.
evidenceIndex.result: Product Truth references removed dsh-933_jrn030_partner_fleet_action_audit.sql while the live migration is dsh-933_partner_fleet_action_audit.sql.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Correcting metadata still requires migration/lifecycle verification and must not rewrite applied history.

evidenceIndex.result: app-captain enters only for Partner fleet and Store↔Captain custody/handoff consequences; unrelated Captain work is excluded.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Runtime counterpart evidence is still required.

evidenceIndex.result: DSH sections are administration, analytics, catalogs, dashboard, hr, login, marketing, operations, partners, platform, support; WLT finance is separately assessed.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Directory presence alone is not relevance.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines server authorization, idempotency, sensitive-data and migration-integrity expectations.
evidenceIndex.result: Partner/Store/client-provided context cannot become trusted authority; migration history and financial/security evidence must remain governed.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows current Partner runtime transport/CI dependencies.
evidenceIndex.result: Shared mobile/runtime/CI changes affect how Partner evidence is executed but do not become Partner business truth or expand unrelated mobile scope.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Transport/CI configuration does not prove Partner functionality.

entries.name: bthwani2-boop/bthwani-suite-next
entries.summary: Repository is the bounded evidence source; implementation is restricted to Partner-proven paths.

entries.name: control-panel
entries.summary: Only Partner-specific operator counterparts are in scope; generic Control Panel work is excluded.

entries.name: app-client
entries.summary: Only mandatory Partner-originated publication/order/custody/support readback compatibility is in scope; independent Client commerce is excluded.

entries.name: app-partner
entries.summary: Primary surface: Partner session/readiness, Store scope, onboarding feedback, orders, catalog/publication, team/fleet, custody/support, WLT finance and analytics/commercial readback.

entries.name: app-captain
entries.summary: Only Partner fleet, Store↔Captain custody/handoff and same support-contract compatibility are in scope; Captain workforce/independent UX/finance are excluded.

entries.name: app-field
entries.summary: Only Partner onboarding/evidence and direct field-rating counterpart behavior required by the Partner onboarding relationship are in scope; Field workforce/independent operations are excluded.

entries.name: administration
entries.summary: Only Partner role/permission behavior that gates Partner access/team operations is included.

entries.name: analytics
entries.summary: Only compatibility with Partner/Store analytics facts and the selected-Store contract is included.

entries.name: catalogs
entries.summary: Only central catalog/publication controls directly affecting Partner assortment/media/stock/price and Store publication are included.

entries.name: dashboard
entries.summary: Generic dashboard is not a canonical Partner writer/readback.
entries.exclusionReason: No current Partner Product Truth or source makes the generic dashboard mandatory to a Partner transition.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if current pinned evidence proves a specific dashboard operation is mandatory to a Partner journey.

entries.name: hr
entries.summary: Generic Workforce HR is not Partner business/team truth.
entries.exclusionReason: Partner onboarding may reference a field actor, but independent Workforce employment/profile management is outside this Partner package.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if current Product Truth assigns a Partner invariant directly to HR.

entries.name: login
entries.summary: Generic operator login does not own app-partner session or Partner state.
entries.exclusionReason: Partner runtime uses its Identity session-surface boundary; generic Control Panel login is unrelated infrastructure.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only for a proven Partner-specific operator-auth dependency beyond generic login.

entries.name: marketing
entries.summary: Only Store visibility/publication gates and Partner offers proven to affect Partner publication are included.

entries.name: operations
entries.summary: Only Partner order decisions, custody/handoff exceptions and governed order rescue counterparts are included.

entries.name: partners
entries.summary: Direct Partner onboarding/review, Store linking, activation and Partner fleet operator readback are included.

entries.name: platform
entries.summary: Only serviceability/capacity/delivery-mode policy gating Partner Store readiness/publication/fulfillment is included.

entries.name: support
entries.summary: Operator support/incident/rescue counterpart for Partner tickets/orders is included; unrelated support administration is excluded.

entries.name: finance
entries.summary: Only WLT-owned Partner destination/payout/COD/settlement/commission/reconciliation controls and readback required by Partner finance are included.

entries.name: DSH_SHARED_FRONTEND
entries.summary: Only shared modules actually imported by Partner flows or serving their canonical contracts are included.

entries.name: DSH_BACKEND
entries.summary: Canonical Partner operational APIs, authorization, ratings, fleet and bounded WLT orchestration are in scope; unrelated backend domains are not.

entries.name: DSH_DATABASE
entries.summary: Only persistence/migrations/invariants required by Partner/Store/order/team/fleet/rating/custody/support facts are in scope.

entries.name: WLT_RELATED
entries.summary: Partner payout prerequisite and Partner finance truth are in scope only at WLT-owned boundaries.

entries.name: CONTRACTS_AND_CLIENTS
entries.summary: OpenAPI/operation IDs/generated clients directly used by Partner slices must stay aligned.

entries.name: EVENTS_JOBS_INTEGRATIONS
entries.summary: Only events/jobs/reconciliation directly emitted or consumed by Partner state-changing journeys are included.

entries.name: IDENTITY_AUTHORIZATION_SECURITY
entries.summary: Partner role/session/refresh/trusted-context/Store/object isolation, rating scope and Partner financial access controls are mandatory.

entries.name: TESTS_AND_QUALITY
entries.summary: Targeted contract/domain/database/runtime/security/finance/RTL/accessibility verification is included only for affected Partner slices.

entries.name: RUNTIME_AND_OBSERVABILITY
entries.summary: Partner mobile session/device/push/runtime transport/API correlation and canonical readback require exact-candidate evidence.

entries.name: CI_TOOLING_AUTOMATION
entries.summary: Only current guards/CI/checks needed to prove affected Partner paths are included; unrelated tool cleanup is excluded.

entries.name: GOVERNANCE_AND_OWNERSHIP
entries.summary: Only authority, migration governance and Product Truth constraining included Partner slices are in scope; stale canonical evidence is a closure defect, while derived plans cannot create policy.
